fields.postcondition: each PostgreSQL collection resolves connection strings and resilience policies through the 5-level configuration hierarchy using PgGlobalPropertiesOptions as the global fallback
fields.response: forward configOptions, globalOptions?.Value, new DataProviderServiceFactory() (or the caller-supplied IDataProviderServiceFactory on the protected constructors), and logger to DatabasesBase<PgDbConnectionOptions> or ShardSetsBase<PgShardConnectionOptions>
fields.subject: PgDatabases and PgShardSets
fields.trigger: PgDatabases or PgShardSets is constructed via its public DI constructor or protected factory constructor
